description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hapugaspitiya, Doluwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320072
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, locations, and ownership details) by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership registration, property boundaries, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
